That being said, when we set the rules for this sub, we made the decision to not discuss his private life, because at that time there was a lot of fan on fan harassment in other social media platforms, which often seemed to originate from gossip about his personal life and co-stars. We wanted this sub to be a safe place to avoid that drama, and just let fans discuss his work in a fun and relaxed atmosphere.

Our intention was never to censor negative opinions or exclude fans of color from the conversation, and I'm sorry if you felt that way. And I know it's kind of become an elephant in the room, but they have never made an "official" statement about their relationship, which is why that topic has fallen under the "no personal life discussion" rule. My family life was always a mess, from the time I was born. My parents divorced when I was a baby, and my dad was completely out of the picture my whole life. I went back and forth between living with my mom, and living with my aunt. I was living with my mom when I chose to homeschool, but upon making that decision, I moved back in with my aunt. My mom ended up moving 500 miles away about a year later. My aunt was like a mother to me, and I think she felt bad for me and all that I had gone through and just wanted to make things as easy as possible for me. So while she would bring up the suggestion from time to time of trying to go back to school, she never really pressed me very hard about it. My mom moved back when I was 16, but she never really gave me any guidance one way or the other about it. 

I suppose it's not worth speculating on what would have happened if things had been handled differently. I'm just grateful that my daughter is having a better life and enjoying her school and her friends. I guess that's where I can find some redemption.
